subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should the remaining fix for this issue be a narrow Telegram plain-group updateLastRoute repair, a broader shared inbound non-direct delivery-context fallback, or deferred until live Telegram restart proof is captured?
rationale: The source gap is real enough to keep open, but the narrow Telegram fix and broad shared fallback have different ownership and compatibility consequences that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
options.body: Run a live plain-group restart proof, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence without broadening shared fallback behavior unless the proof points there.

options.title: Adopt shared fallback
options.body: Use a shared non-direct delivery-context fallback as the canonical fix, but require compatibility review across channel plugins before merge.

options.title: Wait for live evidence
options.body: Keep the issue marked needs-live-repro until a maintainer or reporter captures current-main restart evidence that identifies the exact remaining loss path.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
recommendation.body: Run a live plain-group restart proof, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence without broadening shared fallback behavior unless the proof points there.
